name: pushpin
title: Pushpin
description: Pin an element while its section scrolls, with pin-top, pinned and pin-bottom states.
improvements: Uses position: sticky, so pinning is smooth and jank-free with no scroll listener or hard-coded pixel boundaries.
Boundaries follow the layout: it pins at its own position and is released at the end of its parent, even when content above changes height.
State changes are reported through IntersectionObservers as data-state and onPinChange.
Works inside scrollable containers as well as the page.
